_source: FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998) Table 12 (single Kc, standard climate RHmin 45%, u2 2 m/s) and Table 11 (stage lengths). Fetched https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm on 2026-11-07. Quinoa and chia are NOT in FAO-56 (literature, unverified). Adjust Kc_mid/Kc_end for climate with FAO-56 Eq. 62 when RHmin != 45% or u2 != 2 m/s.
_stage_note: stages_days_fao56 is the FAO-56 row quoted; stages_days_santacruz rescales it to the FAO Crop Calendar growing_days for AEZ 003 (Oriental plains) or local practice. The rescaled numbers are a proposal, not a source value.

rice.note: Santa Cruz rice is mostly rainfed/upland; Kc_ini 1.05 assumes flooded paddy - use ~0.5-0.7 for rainfed upland rice (assumption).

sugarcane.note: ratoon crop; use FAO-56 ratoon row for most fields

quinoa.source: Garcia et al. 2003, Agric. Water Manage. (Bolivian Altiplano lysimeters)

chia.source: Lysimeter study, Majes irrigation (Arequipa, Peru), May-Oct; thesis-level evidence

_verified_by: Table 12 rows for potato/soy/sunflower/wheat/maize/rice/sugarcane and Table 11 rows for soy/sunflower/sorghum/rice/sugarcane/potato parsed from the FAO HTML; maize Table 11 row and sorghum Kc_mid/end came via a page summary.
